list_load_balancers.title: List load balancers
list_load_balancers.description: List ALB instances in the connection's region, optionally by ID, name, VPC or status. Each result carries its DNS name, edition and zones.

load_balancer_name.description: Return only instances with this name.

vpc_id.description: Return only instances in this VPC.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

output.description: The instances in LoadBalancers and a NextToken.

get_load_balancer.title: Get a load balancer
get_load_balancer.description: Read one ALB instance: DNS name, zones and vSwitches, edition, billing, deletion protection, access log and modification protection settings.

load_balancer_id.description: The ALB instance ID, e.g. alb-o9ulmq5hgn68jk****.

create_load_balancer.title: Create a load balancer
create_load_balancer.description: Create an ALB instance across two zones (ALB requires at least two). Billed from creation. Returns at once; the instance is Provisioning until it turns Active.

vpc_id.description: The VPC to create the instance in.

pay_type.description: The billing method; only pay-as-you-go is offered.

vswitch_1_id.description: A vSwitch in the first zone.

vswitch_2_id.description: A vSwitch in the second zone.

deletion_protection.description: Turn deletion protection on at creation.

resource_group_id.description: The resource group to put it in.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

output.description: The LoadBalancerId and an asynchronous JobId.

update_load_balancer.title: Rename a load balancer
update_load_balancer.description: Change an ALB instance's name or its modification protection setting.

load_balancer_id.description: The ALB instance ID, e.g. alb-o9ulmq5hgn68jk****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

update_load_balancer_edition.title: Change edition
update_load_balancer_edition.description: Upgrade an ALB instance's edition (Basic to Standard, or Standard to WAF-enabled). Downgrades are not offered.

load_balancer_id.description: The ALB instance ID, e.g. alb-o9ulmq5hgn68jk****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

delete_load_balancer.title: Delete a load balancer
delete_load_balancer.description: Delete an ALB instance with its listeners and rules. Traffic to its DNS name stops at once. Fails while deletion protection is on.

load_balancer_id.description: The ALB instance ID, e.g. alb-o9ulmq5hgn68jk****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

enable_deletion_protection.title: Enable deletion protection
enable_deletion_protection.description: Turn on deletion protection so the instance cannot be deleted until it is turned off again.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

disable_deletion_protection.title: Disable deletion protection
disable_deletion_protection.description: Turn off deletion protection, which is the step before an ALB instance can be deleted.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_listeners.title: List listeners
list_listeners.description: List the listeners on one or all ALB instances, with protocol, port, status and default action.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

get_listener.title: Get a listener
get_listener.description: Read one listener: protocol, port, default forward action, certificates, timeouts, HTTP/2, gzip and X-Forwarded-For settings.

create_listener.title: Create a listener
create_listener.description: Add a listener to an ALB instance that forwards by default to one server group. HTTPS and QUIC listeners need a certificate.

load_balancer_id.description: The ALB instance ID, e.g. alb-o9ulmq5hgn68jk****.

default_server_group_id.description: The server group the default action forwards to.

default_action_type.description: The default action type; ForwardGroup forwards to the server group.

certificate_id.description: The certificate ID for HTTPS or QUIC.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

output.description: The ListenerId and an asynchronous JobId.

update_listener.title: Update a listener
update_listener.description: Change a listener's description, default server group, certificate, timeouts or HTTP/2 and gzip settings.

default_server_group_id.description: A new default server group (also set default_action_type).

default_action_type.description: The default action type when changing the default server group.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

start_listener.title: Start a listener
start_listener.description: Start a stopped listener so it accepts traffic again.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

stop_listener.title: Stop a listener
stop_listener.description: Stop a listener; clients on its port get connection errors until it is started again.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

delete_listener.title: Delete a listener
delete_listener.description: Delete a listener and its forwarding rules.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_rules.title: List forwarding rules
list_rules.description: List forwarding rules for a listener or instance, with their conditions (host, path, header) and actions.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

create_path_rule.title: Create a path forwarding rule
create_path_rule.description: Add a rule to a listener that forwards requests whose path matches a pattern (for example /api/*) to a server group. Lower priority numbers are evaluated first.

priority.description: Evaluation order (1-10000, lower first, unique per listener).

condition_type.description: The condition type; Path matches the URL path.

action_type.description: The action type; ForwardGroup forwards to a server group.

action_order.description: The action's order within the rule (1-50000).

server_group_id.description: The server group to forward to.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

output.description: The RuleId and an asynchronous JobId.

delete_rule.title: Delete a forwarding rule
delete_rule.description: Delete a forwarding rule; matching requests fall through to the next rule or the default action.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_server_groups.title: List server groups
list_server_groups.description: List server groups with their protocol, type, scheduler, health check and the VPC they belong to.

server_group_name.description: Return only groups with this name.

vpc_id.description: Return only groups in this VPC.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

output.description: The server groups and a NextToken.

create_server_group.title: Create a server group
create_server_group.description: Create a server group to put backends behind. Instance groups take ECS/ENI/ECI backends; Ip groups take addresses; Fc groups take one Function Compute function.

vpc_id.description: The VPC (required except for Fc groups).

health_check_path.description: The HTTP path to check, e.g. /health.

health_check_codes.description: A healthy status class, e.g. http_2xx.

sticky_session_enabled.description: Keep a client on the same backend.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

output.description: The ServerGroupId and an asynchronous JobId.

delete_server_group.title: Delete a server group
delete_server_group.description: Delete a server group. It must not be referenced by any listener or rule.

server_group_id.description: The server group ID, e.g. sgp-cige6j5e7p****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_server_group_servers.title: List backends in a server group
list_server_group_servers.description: List the backends in a server group with their port, weight and status.

server_group_id.description: The server group ID, e.g. sgp-cige6j5e7p****.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

add_server.title: Add a backend
add_server.description: Add one backend to a server group. Call once per backend.

server_group_id.description: The server group ID, e.g. sgp-cige6j5e7p****.

server_id.description: The backend's ID: an ECS instance, ENI or ECI ID, an IP address, or a Function Compute ARN.

port.description: The backend port (1-65535); not used for Fc.

weight.description: The backend's weight (0-100); 0 sends it no new traffic.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

remove_server.title: Remove a backend
remove_server.description: Remove one backend from a server group; in-flight connections are drained according to the group's settings.

server_group_id.description: The server group ID, e.g. sgp-cige6j5e7p****.

server_id.description: The backend's ID: an ECS instance, ENI or ECI ID, an IP address, or a Function Compute ARN.

port.description: The backend port (1-65535); not used for Fc.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_acls.title: List ACLs
list_acls.description: List access control lists (IP allow and deny lists) and the listeners they are attached to.

acl_name.description: Return only ACLs with this name.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

create_acl.title: Create an ACL
create_acl.description: Create an empty access control list; add entries with add_acl_entry and attach it to a listener.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

delete_acl.title: Delete an ACL
delete_acl.description: Delete an access control list. It must be detached from every listener first.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_acl_entries.title: List ACL entries
list_acl_entries.description: List the CIDR entries in an access control list.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

add_acl_entry.title: Add an ACL entry
add_acl_entry.description: Add one CIDR block to an access control list.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

remove_acl_entry.title: Remove an ACL entry
remove_acl_entry.description: Remove one CIDR block from an access control list.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

associate_acl_with_listener.title: Attach an ACL to a listener
associate_acl_with_listener.description: Attach an access control list to a listener as an allow list (White) or deny list (Black).

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

dissociate_acl_from_listener.title: Detach an ACL from a listener
dissociate_acl_from_listener.description: Detach an access control list from a listener; traffic is no longer filtered by it.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and permissions; change nothing.

list_security_policies.title: List custom TLS policies
list_security_policies.description: List custom TLS security policies (protocol versions and cipher suites) for HTTPS listeners.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

list_system_security_policies.title: List system TLS policies
list_system_security_policies.description: List the predefined TLS security policies ALB offers, such as tls_cipher_policy_1_2.

list_zones.title: List zones
list_zones.description: List the zones in the connection's region where ALB can be deployed.

list_regions.title: List regions
list_regions.description: List the regions ALB is available in, with their endpoints.

get_job.title: Get asynchronous job status
get_job.description: Check the status of an asynchronous ALB job by the JobId a create, update or delete call returned.
